text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy crosses the finish in<n>first place! Her
talent is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy puts on an undeniable<n>display of
strength, as if devouring<n>any and every obstacle in
her path.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy! You really did it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: How'd ya like that?! Told ya Windy's<n>the best...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the initial thrill of crossing the<n>finish has
subsided, she approaches<n>the winner's circle.
However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with all of you? Didn't ya<n>see me win
just now?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Who knew she had that in<n>her?! Holy
moly! Did you see those<n>powerful strides? So
freaking cool!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What awe-inspiring drive! She's the<n>embodiment of
fighting spirit! I'm still<n>shaking after witnessing that
run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Yeah, Windy! You were<n>awesome!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wowiee! Congrats! You were so cool!<n>☆ Ooh, my
heart won't stop pounding!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Such powerful qi! It's like you were<n>never down in
the dumps at all... You<n>showed everyone that fate
can be<n>changed!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! I wonder if I can<n>follow in your
footsteps... Ambition,<n>you called it? I have a dream I
want to<n>make come true, too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It's been a long, long<n>journey, but you've
done just swell!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're just so dang cool!<n>Congratulations! I'm so
happy for<n>you, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko... You guys...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was so crazy! Who the heck<n>ever called her a
clown?! She's<n>insanely talented!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
This is what I've been trying to tell<n>everybody all
along! Windy has true<n>skill as a runner!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
She's a bit unconventional, but she<n>believes in
herself more than anyone<n>else, and can do things
nobody else<n>can with ease! That's why she's so
strong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrraagh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrroooaaarrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rwaaaarrr! I'm the greatest ever!<n>GAAAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She joyously bounds around while<n>the crowd
showers her with unabated<n>applause.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WINDY! WINDY! WINDY! WINDY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are no doubters left. All of them<n>see Shinko
Windy's strength!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, lackey. And I gave all my<n>fans exactly
what they wanted.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Heh-heh, heeheehee! ...I feel<n>kinda weird,
though.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My arms and legs feel all jittery! I<n>can't stay still!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Traineeerrr! TRAINEEERRR!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nibble, nibble!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAWWWRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear as day that Shinko Windy<n>can't contain
her pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory! That<n>was a
spectacular display of<n>overwhelming strength. Can
you<n>share a few words on how you're<n>feeling?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, on top of the world,<n>obviously! You're all
finally afraid of<n>me—Wicked Windy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I certainly had goose bumps! I bet<n>many
Umamusume will be lining up to<n>challenge you from
now on! We look<n>forward to your clashes with the
new<n>generation.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ♪ I'll take 'em all on! They'll<n>regret the day
they thought of<n>challengin' me!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: This is so wonderful, Windy! All thesepeople finally accept you. Sniffle...Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm really impressed with Shinko<n>Windy. The way
she focuses on the<n>racetrack, it's like she's a
completely<n>different person out there. I think I've
become a fan!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Did I hear what I think I just<n>heard?! That's
great! Please pay<n>more attention to her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you a fan of Windy's?! Would<n>you mind
telling me more about her?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'd like to listen in, too! I thought<n>she was a bit
of a joke at first, but<n>seeing her knock out the
competition<n>today has changed my mind!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's her tenacious desire for<n>victory
speaking to me, but she was<n>sparkling out there!
Were her past<n>races just as amazing?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You bet they were!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Windy's far more than just an<n>amusing
personality! Her talent for<n>racing is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Heeheehee... Social<n>media,
streaming sites, even the<n>news...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The whole world is obsessed with<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Our big bad plan is progressin'<n>smoothly. Now, we
just need the URA<n>to take the bait and cough up
that<n>award...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this exciting, my diabolical<n>strategist? Soon, all
of Japan will<n>cower before me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The media is abuzz about Shinko<n>Windy's talent,
and her biting incident<n>seems to have become a
distant<n>memory at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things are going according to plan for<n>our big prank
as well. It's just a little<n>longer until she leaves
everyone lost<n>for words!
